items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: And Ms. Emma Rose Williams. That's the name of some of the teachers.

ctx.x: Who were some of the teachers? Oh, yes.

I had quite a few teachers. I had some of the names of the teachers. The later teachers was Mrs. Lewis. She came around on Fridays. Taught music, vocal music. Mrs. Lewis. And we had Mr. Vega. That's the name of some of the teachers. Mrs. Vega. And Ms. Emma Rose Williams. That's the name of some of the teachers. Emma Rose Williams.
What did Ms. Lewis teach you? Ms. Lewis, she taught music. Yeah, but I mean what did she teach you personally? Did she teach you music in general? No. Or one particular instrument?
